targets.authors: Ruiz JR, Buxens A, Artieda M, Arteta D, Santiago C, Rodriguez-Romo G, Lao JI, Gomez-Gallego F & Lucia A
targets.title: The -174 G/C polymorphism of the IL6 gene is associated with elite power performance.
targets.evidence_quote: To replicate our recent findings (Ruiz et al., 2010b) we compared allelic and genotypic frequencies of IL6 -174 C/G polymorphism among elite endurance athletes and power athletes, and non-athletic controls from Israel.
targets.outcome_quote: In summary, the results of the present study did not show an association between the G allele of the IL6 -174 G/C polymorphism and power sports performance in the Israeli (Caucasian) population. Previous data on a different cohort (Ruiz et al., 2010b), could not be corroborated with the present ethnic group.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly conclude that the prior power-performance association was not corroborated. The endurance comparison is ancillary to the central power finding.

reasoning: New Israeli athlete and control samples re-test the published Spanish power-performance association; pooled analyses also include the original cohort. Identity verified from manuscript title and authors.
